articles.title: India's largest exchange denies hack after sleuths pointed to $16 million in suspicious outflows
articles.snippet: CoinDCX denies its active wallets were hacked after sleuths flagged $16 million in outflows from addresses linked to the India-based exchange.

articles.title: Malaysia, Thailand join Singapore’s cross-border stablecoin push
articles.snippet: BLOOM seeks to cut costs by helping financial institutions coordinate cross-border use of stablecoins and tokenized deposits.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

articles.title: Bitcoin hashrate hits seven-month high as AI shift fails to ease mining competition
articles.snippet: According to BlocksBridge, Bitcoin’s mining difficulty is rising despite the industry’s AI transition, with smaller operators potentially absorbing equipment abandoned by larger competitors.

articles.title: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
articles.snippet: Meta will hand shareholders a free non-voting share for every share they own in January, giving it a way to raise equity for AI spending without diluting Zuckerberg's 60.6% vote.
